packrat plan  datadog-gem-and-agent  Rails 8.0.2

  SIGNAL      SOURCE          INSTALLED  STEP
  Exceptions  Sentry          ✓          dual-ship to Packrat
      sentry-ruby sends; Packrat takes the same envelope
  Traces      Datadog         ✓          dual-ship from the Agent
      Agent config at docker-compose.yml:5
  Logs        Datadog         ✓          dual-ship from the Agent
      same Agent
  Replays     Sentry browser             add the Sentry browser SDK
      Packrat accepts Sentry envelopes

  Traces do not use OpenTelemetry: the datadog gem and the OpenTelemetry Net::HTTP
  instrumentation collide.

Add --app service/env to detect if Packrat is receiving data from each signal.
